title: SteerVTE: Seamless Video Text Editing with Style and Glyph Control
abstract: arXiv:2606.23254v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual text editing aims to precisely modify text in images and videos while preserving stylistic consistency and visual realism. Despite significant advances in the image domain, video text editing remains largely unexplored: it is a localized task demanding stroke-level precision within small text regions, which compounds the challenges of cross-frame accuracy, temporal coherence, and stylistic fidelity. We introduce SteerVTE, a unified framework that steers a frozen video diffusion model to perform precise Video Text Editing through style and glyph control. Built on a frozen diffusion transformer, SteerVTE attaches a lightweight text context adapter with two complementary modules: a style encoder capturing the original text's visual attributes, and dual-granularity glyph encoders encoding the target text at both the line and character levels. translated_title: SteerVTE：具有风格与字形控制的无缝视频文本编辑
translated_abstract: 视觉文本编辑旨在精确修改图像和视频中的文本，同时保持风格一致性与视觉真实性。尽管在图像领域已取得显著进展，视频文本编辑在很大程度上仍处于未探索状态：这是一项局部化任务，要求在小文本区域内达到笔画级精度，这进一步加剧了跨帧准确性、时序一致性和风格保真度方面的挑战。我们提出SteerVTE，一个统一框架，通过风格与字形控制来引导冻结的视频扩散模型执行精确的视频文本编辑。SteerVTE构建于冻结的扩散变换器之上，附加了一个轻量级文本上下文适配器，其中包含两个互补模块：一个捕捉原始文本视觉属性的风格编码器，以及以行级和字符级双粒度编码目标文本的双粒度字形编码器。为克服视频基础模型固有的文本渲染先验较弱的问题……
tldr: SteerVTE通过风格编码器与行级、字符级双粒度字形编码器引导冻结的视频扩散模型，实现了兼具风格一致性与笔画级精度的无缝视频文本编辑。
en_tdlr: SteerVTE steers a frozen video diffusion model with a style encoder and dual line/character-level glyph encoders to achieve seamless video text editing with precise style and glyph control.
